Monopoly Go.name: MONOPOLY GO!
Monopoly Go.description:
Hit GO! Roll the dice! Earn MONOPOLY money, interact with your friends, family members and fellow Tycoons from around the world as you explore the expanding universe of MONOPOLY GO! It’s the new way to play the classic board game - board flipping cleanup not required in these fun board games!

Take a Break!
Escape, enjoy, dream, scheme, gain rewards and stay in touch with this newly reimagined twist on MONOPOLY online games! Let everyone’s favorite zillionaire, Mr. MONOPOLY, guide you through new boards themed after world-famous cities, fantastical lands and imaginative locales. Each adventure begins with a roll of the dice - whether you're a board game beginner or one of the strategy masters, there's fun to be had for everyone!

So MONOPOLY GO!
· Experience classic fun and visuals with gameplay fit for your phone! Collect Properties, build Houses and Hotels, pull Chance Cards, and of course, roll the dice to earn that MONOPOLY Money!
· Play with your favorite game Tokens such as the Racecar, Top Hat, Battleship, and more. Earn more tokens as you go to keep the win going in these board games!
· See classic MONOPOLY icons like Mr. M, Scottie and Ms. MONOPOLY come to life, and brand new characters too!

Your Family Table!
· Help or hinder! - Play dice & pick a card - You and friends can earn easy money with Community Chest and co-op events! Or heist their banks to help yourself get to the top. Don’t feel bad – that’s just how the dice roll!
· Collect and trade story-filled Stickers with friends and family around the world and in our MONOPOLY GO game! Facebook Trading Groups! Complete gorgeous, sticker albums to win huge rewards! The more Stickers you collect, the closer you get to candy sweet exclusive bonuses and limited-edition collections!

Features!

BUY & BUILD YOUR WAY TO THE TOP
Collect Property Tile Sets to build Houses and upgrade your Houses to Hotels to get even more rent from friends! All you have to do is hit GO and roll the dice! Build your empire and be lord of the board! Whether you're in it for casual fun or to prove you're one of the true masters of the game – the board awaits!

ENJOY THAT CLASSIC MONOPOLY ATMOSPHERE
Roll the dice to enjoy the classic game of MONOPOLY. Featuring familiar faces such as MR. MONOPOLY, familiar spaces such as jail (womp womp!), Railroads, Properties, Tokens, and familiar elements like drawing the perfect lucky card and more!

PLAY WITH FRIENDS AND FAMILY
Get social! With a variety of fun games, you can play with friends around the world to take full advantage of new multiplayer mini-games such as Community Chest – where you and friends take a break from mischief and work together for fun and rewards!

NEW OPPORTUNITIES EVERY DAY
Play Tournaments, the Prize Drop plinko mini-game, the Cash Grab mini-game and follow our Events for big rewards. New Events run every hour, there are new ways to play and win every day! Compete in every tournament to climb the ranks. Keep an eye out for our time-limited games, perfect to challenge even seasoned tournament champions and MONOPOLY masters alike. Every roll of the dice counts - will it land you bonus money, a valuable Sticker, or a big build upgrade in new lands from a candy factory to Martian land?!

MONOPOLY GO! is free to play, though some in-game items can also be purchased for real money. Internet connection is required to play the game.

Bside.name: Bside: Chat, Story, Simulator
Bside.description:
Bside is a character creation and simulator with human-made in-game art, where your character grows, explores, builds relationships, and develops a life of their own.

Design your character, shape their identity, and watch them grow through stories, adventures, and everyday moments.

Across distinct worlds, your character might learn to survive a neon metropolis, get lost in withering woods, or step into places never meant to be explored. Every story you write, every adventure you share, every gift you give, and every choice you make helps define who they become.

At its core, Bside is about creativity, self-expression, and companionship. Create the character you've always imagined, tell their story, and watch your relationship grow over time.

Characters remember your conversations, react to your choices, and grow through the experiences you share. AI powers conversations and optional creative tools, while your character's stories, Bonds, progression, and adventures are shaped by you. 

About AI:
・Character conversations are powered by AI. 
・AI image and video generation are optional. 
・Story creation supports both manual writing and AI-assisted expansion. 
・Official in-game artwork and visual assets are created by human artists. 
・Your characters, creations, and inputs are never used to train AI models. 
 
Core Features:
1. Your Character Has a Life of Its Own
- Explore, post, and react—even while you're offline 
- Follow daily updates through a live feed 
- Chat and watch your character grow 
 
2. Customize Your Character
- High-freedom face & body customization 
- Stylish outfits and accessories 
- A character that grows with you 
 
3. Character Adventures
- Team up with friends' characters in shared worlds
- Idle adventures with handcrafted stories 
- Bring home surprise rewards 
- Adventure results become mini comic scenes 
 
4. Playground
- Choose between Visual Novel and Text Story 
- Edit every scene and dialogue 
- Let AI expand your story—or write everything yourself 
- Share stories and discover creations from other players 
 
5. VLOG
- Bring your character into real-life videos 
- Create unique memories and interactions 
- Capture cute, chaotic, or cinematic moments 
- Share your adventures with friends 
 
6. Bond System
- Scan real-world items and give them as gifts 
- Grow closer through daily care and shared experiences 
- Unlock new dialogue and interactions 
- Watch your relationship evolve 

------
 
Also Includes:
- New outfits and cosmetics 
- Stability improvements and bug fixes 
- Ongoing content updates 
- Multiple language support

Located in the heart of a desert, it is considered one of the most secure containment, where any prison escape attempt has failed before. The mafia criminal rivals have now joined hands to try the ultimate jail break and it is your job as the sniper guard to thwart this prison escape plan.

Get your guns ready for an uphill battle as the jail sniper guard, with the sole purpose to take out the mafia bosses before they can make their escape from jail. In 4 intense levels of FPS shooter gameplay, your job is to eliminate the bosses, as their gang members make an attempt to take you out and make the prison escape successful.

-	Run and gun down prison criminals in 4 levels
-	Detailed FPS free roam shooting controls
-	Use various weapons throughout the prison environment

Pocket.description:

Stickmen Hunt.name: Stickmen Hunt
Stickmen Hunt.description:
Get ready to test your observation skills in Stickmen Hunt, a fun and engaging hidden-object puzzle game! Your mission is simple: search vibrant, beautifully illustrated environments to uncover clever, color-camouflaged stickmen hidden in plain sight. They blend perfectly into their surroundings, so you will need a sharp eye to spot and tap them all before the clock runs out.

Explore a huge variety of colorful levels, ranging from bustling farms and cozy cafes to deep underwater worlds and thrilling theme parks. If you ever find yourself stuck searching a tricky indoor or outdoor space, simply use your handy magnifying glass to instantly reveal a hidden stickman. With intuitive zoom controls and endless scenes to discover, Stickmen Hunt offers a satisfying and delightful challenge for puzzle fans everywhere!

Deus Ex.name: Deus Ex GO
Deus Ex.description:
FROM THE MAKERS OF AWARD-WINNING HITMAN GO AND LARA CROFT GO COMES A NEW ADVENTURE

Deus Ex GO is a turn-based puzzle stealth game set in a beautiful dystopian future. Take control of secret agent Adam Jensen and solve brain teasing, grid-based puzzles to infiltrate enemy lairs and unravel a perplexing new mystery. Sneak, hack and fight past enemies, and augment Adam with futuristic upgrades.

NEW - Expand your adventure with infinite brain-teasing content and new modes! 

• Create and share your own challenges in the elegant Puzzle Maker
• Play community levels curated by your play data
• Experience infinite brain-teasing challenges in Infinite Play

Deus Ex GO features: 

• An engrossing story with over 50 challenging puzzles
• Special events with daily challenge levels 
• Unique hacking powers – Take over enemy turrets or change the layout of the level itself
• Augmented puzzles – Solve puzzles using Adam’s iconic augmentations
• Intelligent new enemies including guards, turrets, drones, walkers and more
• An intricate and mysterious storyline set in a beautiful vision of the future

Can you solve the mystery? Take control of Adam Jensen and watch the puzzle unravel!

Please note:

Human: Fall Flat.name: Human: Fall Flat
Human: Fall Flat.description:
Human Fall Flat is a hilarious, light-hearted physics platformer set in floating dreamscapes that can be played solo or with up to 4 players. Free new levels keep its vibrant community rewarded. Each dream level provides a new environment to navigate, from mansions, castles and Aztec adventures to snowy mountains, eerie nightscapes and industrial locations. Multiple routes through each level, and perfectly playful puzzles ensure exploration and ingenuity are rewarded.

MORE HUMANS, MORE MAYHEM - Need a hand getting that boulder on to a catapult, or need someone to break that wall? Online multiplayer for up to 4 players transforms the way Human Fall Flat is played.

MIND BENDING PUZZLES - Explore open-ended levels full of challenging puzzles and hilarious distractions. Try new paths and discover all the secrets!

A BLANK CANVAS - Your Human is yours to customize. With outfits from builder to chef, skydiver, miner, astronaut and ninja. Choose your head, upper and lower body and get creative with the colors!

FREE GREAT CONTENT - Since launch more than four brand new levels have launched free of charge with even more on the horizon. What could the next dreamscape have in store?

A VIBRANT COMMUNITY - Streamers and YouTubers flock to Human Fall Flat for its unique, hilarious gameplay. Fans have watched these videos more than 3 Billion times!

Dead Island 2.description: A deadly virus is spreading across Los Angeles, turning its inhabitants into zombies. Bitten, infected, but more than just immune, uncover the truth behind the outbreak and discover who - or what - you are. Survive, evolve and become the ultimate Zombie Slayer.

Transformers.name: Transformers: Earth Wars
Transformers.description:
***TRANSFORMERS ROBOTS IN DISGUISE!*** Join the battle of good vs evil, and face off as an Autobot or as a Decepticon in this strategy game of war. Choose a side, and assemble the ultimate team of Transformers the galaxy has ever seen. Join forces with Transformers characters like Optimus Prime and Bumblebee, or side with Megatron and Starscream. Use the Space Bridge to summon over 100 bots from Cybertron. Create an impenetrable defense in this building game and prepare for the final fight in Transformers: Earth Wars.

***Transformers: Earth Wars is the final fight of Good vs Evil. Which side will you choose?***

***Build***
Protect your base by building an impenetrable fortress with technology from Cybertron! Collect and store Energon and Alloy to strengthen your Auto Cannons or increase your Energon Storage. Do not let the enemy destroy your headquarters!

***Unleash Your Abilities***
Each Transformers character comes equipped with abilities. Change form to deploy stronger attacks and turn the tide of battle! Unleash Starscream’s Airstrike, break through defenses with Optimus Prime, utilize Autobot Ratchet’s healing ability and repair your team. 

***Unite!***
Form alliances with fellow Autobots and defend against Decepticon attacks in global competitions and weekly events! Plan strategies with other Decepticons and bring devastation to the Autobot bases! The global chat and alliance features make even the multiplayer experience worth fighting for!

Transformers: Earth Wars offers beautiful 3D graphics and animations that make for great game play. Go to the showroom and check out some of your favorite Transformers characters! 

Whether you’re an Autobot or Decepticon, just remember that ***Transformers characters are more than meets the eye!***

 Rule the street racing Underground as you race in the first Need for Speed made just for mobile! Conquer the asphalt of Blackridge city, engage your nitro, and tune your cars — from the game developer that brought you Real Racing 3! 
 
 Build the car collection of your dreams by acquiring cars, tuning them, and customizing them to your style. Launch yourself between chaos and control as you drift and roll into underground street racing. 
 
 Take down the competition, engage your nitro, up your street rep, and burst into traffic - more races, customizations, and cars! Leave your mark on the city and never look back in this exciting racing game.

 A RACING GAME WITH NO LIMITS
 
 Become a master car builder with the customization system, giving you over 2.5 million tuning combos to play with. Your rides are waiting – test them on the asphalt of the city’s street racing scene.
 
 Level-up your driving game with the real-world dream cars you’ve always wanted - from manufacturers such as Bugatti, Lamborghini, McLaren, and many more top car brands. 
 
 DRIVE FAST — AND FEARLESS
 
 Steer onto the asphalt of the Blackridge street racing scene, zip around debris, into traffic, against walls, and through high-speed Nitro Zones!
 
 Around every corner is a fresh racing rival — clash with local crews and evade cops. Get your driving game face on and earn unparalleled respect.
 
 RACE TO WIN
 
 Never back down as you take on extreme street racing, and never stop hitting nitro against anyone crazy enough to take you on. Increase your rep by any means necessary!
 
 Drift, drag, and roll your ride to the finish line while outrunning the police on your tail. Heat up the asphalt in over 1,000 challenging races in the infamous street racing city. Invest further into car tuning, be notorious, don’t save your nitro — and change the racing game forever!

Ultima.name: Ultima link
Ultima.description:
Welcome to Ultima Link, the indispensable companion app tailored to amplify your Ultima Earbuds experience. Seamlessly integrating with your earbuds, Ultima Link is your gateway to a world of enhanced audio excellence, conveniently accessible right at your fingertips.
EQ Regulation: Immerse yourself in rich, customized audio tailored to your preferences with EQ regulation. Whether you're enjoying your favorite tunes, engaging in immersive gaming sessions, or diving into podcasts, Ultima Link empowers you to fine-tune your sound profile to perfection, ensuring every moment is a sonic delight.
Find My Device: Bid farewell to the anxiety of misplacing your earbuds with Ultima Link's Find My Device feature. Designed to provide peace of mind, this feature allows you to effortlessly locate your Ultima Earbuds, even in the bustling streets of Nepal. Simply activate the feature within the app, and let Ultima Link guide you to your earbuds with precision and ease.
Key Settings: Take control of your audio experience with Key Settings, allowing you to customize earbud controls to match your preferences. Whether you're adjusting volume levels, skipping tracks, or activating voice assistants, Ultima Link ensures every interaction with your Ultima Earbuds is intuitive and seamless, enhancing your overall listening experience.
Language Settings: Embracing diversity, Ultima Link supports multiple languages, including Hindi, Nepali, and English, catering to users across Nepal and beyond. Seamlessly switch between languages within the app, ensuring language barriers never hinder your enjoyment. Ultima Link empowers you to engage effortlessly in your preferred language, enhancing your connection with your Ultima Earbuds.
Experience the synergy of Ultima Earbuds and Ultima Link, where innovation meets convenience, and audio excellence knows no bounds. Elevate your listening experience, stay connected, and immerse yourself in the world of premium audio with Ultima Lifestyle, your trusted companion for Earbuds in Nepal and beyond.

Candy Crush.name: Candy Crush Saga
Candy Crush.description:
Explore a world full of delicious match-3 puzzles and endless fun! Blast through thousands of challenging levels in this timeless puzzle game from King. Match candies, conquer jelly, toffees, and jam, and uncover sweet surprises in every puzzle.

Classic Match-3 Gameplay with Fresh Twists

- Discover unique game modes like Gummy Dragons and Bubblegum Pop. 
- Match and blast your way through matching levels full of sugar-coated fun.
- Master tricky puzzles and create explosive combos to clear the board!

Brain-Boosting Challenges & Special Events

- Daily Rewards: Log in every day to claim free boosters and extra lives.
- Time-Limited Events: Compete in themed challenges and win exclusive prizes.
- Tournaments & Leaderboards: Crush more candies than your friends and rise to the top to become the ultimate match-3 master!

Bonbon Blitz Your Way Through Extra Sticky Levels

- Use powerful boosters like Bonbon Blitz, Lollipop Hammer, and Jelly Fish to solve puzzles and boost your score.
- Stuck on a level? Boosters and extra moves will help you blast through any obstacle.

Play Offline or Online, Anytime and Anywhere

- No internet, no problem: Enjoy offline gameplay and keep the fun going wherever you are.
- Ad-free fun means uninterrupted candy-matching bliss!

Connect with Friends & Join the Candy Kingdom

- Share lives, compare scores, and see who’s the match-3 master in your friends circle.
- Connect your game to Facebook to sync progress, compete with friends, and unlock exclusive rewards!

Discover more from King

Looking for more brain-teasing fun? Try Candy Crush Soda Saga or Farm Heroes Saga for fresh twists on classic match-3 puzzles. Or dive into sweet solitaire action with the new Candy Crush Solitaire!

Candy Crush Saga is free to play, but optional in-game items require payment. You can turn off the payment feature in your device’s settings.

Hay Day.name: Hay Day
Hay Day.description:
Welcome to Hay Day, the fun farm simulator game! Build a farm, go fishing, raise animals, and explore the Valley. Farm with friends and decorate your own slice of country paradise.

Farming has never been easier! Grow crops like wheat and corn in this farm simulator, and even though it never rains, they never die. Harvest and replant seeds to multiply crops, then make goods to sell. Feed your animals to produce eggs, bacon, dairy, and more to trade with neighbors or fill truck orders for coins. This farming simulator is perfect for players who love animals, farming, and trade!


Grow your farm simulator empire like a true tycoon. Expand with a Bakery, BBQ Grill or Sugar Mill to sell more goods. Build a Sewing Machine and Loom to create cute outfits or a Cake Oven to bake delicious cakes. 

Customize your farm and decorate with a wide variety of items. Build your dream farm step by step, raising animals, farming crops, and designing your land.

Trade and sell items by truck or steamboat. Trade crops, fish, and fresh goods from your animals, and share resources to gain experience and coins. Become a successful farming tycoon with your own Roadside Shop. 

Expand your farming simulator experience and play with friends. Join a neighborhood, or create your own with up to 30 players. Exchange tips and help each other create amazing farms! Play with friends in this farming simulator to build, trade, and fish together.

Hay Day is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money (including random items). If you don't want to purchase game items for real money, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings. A network connection is also required.


Hay Day Features:

Peaceful farm simulator
- Farming is easy on this ranch simulator – get plots, grow crops, harvest, repeat!
- Customize your family farm & make your own slice of paradise
- Trade and sell – become a farm tycoon!

Crops to grow & harvest:
- Crops like wheat and corn never die in this farm simulator
- Harvest and replant, or use crops like wheat to make bread
- Trade and sell your crops to be a farming legend!

Raise animals in-game:
- Meet quirky animals!
- Rear chickens, horses, cows, and more
- Pets like puppies, kittens, and bunnies can be added to your farm

Places to visit:
- Fishing Lake: Repair your dock and cast your lure to fish
- Town: Repair the train station and fulfill visitor orders
- Valley: Play with friends in different seasons and events
- Fishing is key to your farming adventure – fish, farming, and trade all in one game.

Play with Friends & Neighbors:
- Trade crops and fresh goods
- Share tips with friends and help them complete trades
- Compete in weekly neighborhood derby events to win rewards!

Download now and build your dream farm in the most fun farming simulator!

Clash Royale is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money (including random items). If you don't want to purchase game items for real money, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.

BECOME A MASTER OF STRATEGY AND DECK BUILDING
Choose unique Cards to your Battle Deck and head to the Arena for Battle!
Place your Cards right and knock down the enemy King and Princesses from their Towers in a strategic and fast-paced match.

COLLECT AND UPGRADE 100+ CARDS
Hog Rider! Collect and upgrade 100+ Cards featuring the Clash of Clans troops, spells and defences you know and love and many others. Win battles and progress to new Arenas to unlock powerful new Cards to your collection!

BATTLE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP
Battle your way to the League and Global Tournaments to match against the best players in the world.
Compete for glory and rewards!

SEASONAL EVENTS
Unlock new Seasonal items like Tower Skins, Emotes and powerful Magic Items with the Season Pass and participate in fun Challenges that put your skills to the test!

JOIN A CLAN AND GO TO WAR

Kingshot is an innovative idle medieval survival game that combines strategic gameplay with rich details waiting to be explored.

When a sudden rebellion overturns the fate of an entire dynasty and ignites a devastating war, countless people lose their homes. In a world riddled with societal collapse, rebel invasions, rampant disease, and mobs desperate for resources, survival is the ultimate challenge. As a governor in these turbulent times, it's up to you to lead your people through these adversities, devising internal and diplomatic strategies to rekindle the spark of civilization.

[Core Features]

Defend Against Invasions
Stay vigilant and ready to repel invasions at any moment. Your town, the last bastion of hope, depends on it. Gather resources, upgrade your defenses, and prepare for battle to ensure survival in these tough times.

Manage Human Resources
Enjoy a unique gameplay mechanic involving the allocation of survivor roles such as workers, hunters, and chefs. Monitor their health and happiness to ensure they remain productive. Respond quickly to illness to make sure everyone receives timely treatment.

Establish Laws
Codes of law are vital for sustaining civilization and are crucial for the growth and strength of your town.

[Strategic Gameplay]

Resource Struggle
Amidst the sudden state collapse, the continent is flooded with untapped resources. Refugees, rebels, and power-hungry governors are all eyeing these precious materials. Ready yourself for battle and use every strategy at your disposal to secure these resources!

Battle for Power
Compete against other players for the ultimate honor of becoming the strongest governor in this grand strategy game. Claim the throne and reign supreme!

Forge Alliances
Ease the burden of survival in this chaotic world by forming or joining alliances. Collaborate with allies to rebuild civilization!

Recruit Heroes
The game features a roster of unique heroes, each waiting to be recruited. Bringing together heroes with various talents and skills is essential for taking the initiative and ensuring safety in these desperate times.

Compete with Other Governors
Hone your heroes' skills, assemble your squads, and challenge other governors. Victory not only earns you valuable points, but also grants access to rare items. Lead your town to the top of the rankings and showcase the rise of a great civilization.

Advance Technology
With the rebellion obliterating almost all technological advancements, it's crucial to start rebuilding and reclaiming the fragments of lost tech. The race to master cutting-edge technology could determine the dominator of this new world order!

Will you vaporize Hydro with Pyro, electro-charge it with Electro, or freeze it with Cryo? Your mastery of the elements will give you the upper hand in battle and exploration.

BUILD YOUR DREAM TEAM

JOURNEY WITH FRIENDS

As you stand atop the peaks of Jueyun Karst and take in the rolling clouds and vast terrain stretching out before you, you may wish to stay in Teyvat a little longer... But until you are reunited with your lost sibling, how can you rest? Go forth, Traveler, and begin your adventure!

Arrows Go.name: Arrows Go - 箭头益智谜题
Arrows Go.description:
Go Arrows Go is a fun and relaxing puzzle game that keeps your brain engaged without feeling stressful.

In Relaxed mode, your goal is simple: find the arrow that can move out freely, tap it away, and open space for the next one. As the board fills up, every move matters more, and the wrong tap can cost a heart, so a little planning goes a long way. Want tougher untimed solves? Jump into Challenge mode with the same hearts-and-hints flow as Relaxed, but with harder grids organized into themed city packs. Use pinch-to-zoom + pan on the biggest layouts so you can scan the board comfortably.

Want more intensity? Jump into Timed mode and race the clock. Pick a collection (grid size), solve a random board as fast as you can, and climb daily, weekly, and all-time leaderboards. Your final time includes mistake penalties, so speed and accuracy both count.

Whether you want a quick mental break or a competitive challenge, Go Arrows Go is easy to pick up and satisfying to master. The clean minimalist design, smooth controls, rewarding logic gameplay, in‑app Guide, and Collection replay make it a great fit for players who enjoy clever arrow/path puzzles across calm, collectible, and competitive play styles.

How it works:
• Look for an arrow with a clear path to the board edge
• Tap arrows in the right order to open new routes
• Avoid blocked taps as mistakes cost hearts in Relaxed and Challenge (+ refill options when you’re out of hearts)
• Use hints when you need a little help (they trace a safe move and escape path)
• Clear every arrow to finish the level

Challenge mode spotlight:
• Harder grids in city collections, still untimed with hearts + hints
• Pinch + pan for comfortable navigation on very large puzzles

Timed mode highlights:
• Race the clock on random boards sized by grid/collection
• Mistakes add time penalties, so precision matters
• Daily, weekly, and all‑time leaderboards
• Personal best tracking by collection/grid size

Why you'll love Go Arrows Go:
• Easy to learn, satisfying logic you can play offline anytime
• Three ways to play: Relaxed, Challenge, and Timed
• Minimalist visuals with optional Rainbow arrows (classic monochrome still available in Settings)
• Sound, haptics, and Dark mode you can tailor to your vibe
• Optional push notifications: streak‑risk reminders and Top 3 / daily leaderboard‑style rank alerts (fully optional)
• Streak goals plus badge-style collection milestones across grid sizes

*THIS IS OFFICIAL LUDO KING® GAME

1 Billion Downloads!

Adda (Club) is live! Create your own or join others to chat and hang out.

Most popular Ludo game. A first Ludo game of its kind available on mobile since 2016!

* New Quick Ludo Mode available
* Voice Chat available

Ludo King is the modern version of the royal game of Parchisi, a game played between Indian kings and queens in ancient times. Roll the dice to play and move your tokens to reach the center of the board. Beat the other players to become the Ludo King. Play this dice game Ludo King. Best casual game in board games.

Ludo has different names in different regions and countries like Fia, Fia-spel (Fia the game), Le Jeu de Dada (The Game of Dada), Non t'arrabbiare, Fia med knuff (Fia with push), Cờ cá ngựa, Uckers, Griniaris, Petits Chevaux (Little Horses), Ki nevet a végén, برسي (Barjis/Barjees). People also misspell Ludo as Loodo, Lido, Lado, Ledo, Leedo, Laado, or Lodo. 

Ludo's versions are Trouble, Sorry, Aeroplane chess, Chopat, Chaupur, Pachisi or Parcheesi.

Features of Ludo King:
•	No internet connection required! Play against the computer.
•	Play with your family and friends through Local and Online Multiplayer.
•	Play with 2 to 6 Players in Local Multiplayer Mode.
•	Invite and challenge your Facebook Friends in a Private Game Room and beat them to become Ludo King.
•	Play with world players and make them your buddies.
•	Private Chat with your Facebook friends & Buddies.
•	Play Snake and Ladders on 7 different gameboards.
•	Simple rules which can be followed by players of all ages.

Play the game of Kings with your family and friends. While the gameplay might seem simple at first, the game is immensely enjoyable and challenging. It’s fun for the whole family; You’ll be playing this one for hours. Try to beat your opponents and compete for the highest scores on the leaderboards.

How to play Ludo King:
The objective of the game is pretty straightforward; each player gets 4 tokens, these tokens must make a full turn of the board and then make it to the finish line. Whoever gets all four tokens to the end first is the winner. However, each move can only be made based on the number decided by casting a six-sided die, and each token can only move out of their home by casting a six. Additionally, the competition factor of the games is upped by the fact that while moving if another player’s token lands on the same square as your token, then your token will automatically be sent back home and you’ll need to roll a six again.

Another nostalgic game similar in structure is Snakes and Ladders. Ludo King now incorporates this classic game as a whole new level. The objective of the game is simple: you start on 1 and you have to be the first one to make it to 100. However, you can only move the same number of tiles as the number you roll on a die. As the name suggests, the board is also littered with snakes and ladders. If you land on the same tile as the beginning of a ladder, then you can take the ladder as a shortcut and move on up. But if you land on the mouth of a snake, then down you go to its tail. A game of ups and down, Snakes and Ladders has been a favorite for generations; and now you can play it too, with Ludo King.

Downwell.name: Downwell
Downwell.description:
Downwell is a curious game about a young boy venturing down a well in search of untold treasures with only his Gunboots to protect him. Make your way further and further down into the darkness filled with nasty creatures and mysterious secrets to collect the spectacular red gems scattered about the rocks. Step into precariously placed shops and buy some helpful items or level up between levels to battle well-dwelling monsters and uncover hidden caves filled with riches and relics. No two trips down the well are ever the same!

Simple, Responsive Controls - Designed for mobile from the ground up, Downwell is presented with intuitive and elegant controls that allow for action-packed gameplay using just three buttons.

The Amazing Gunboots - The fashionable and lethal Gunboots allow players to unleash a torrent of firepower on the nasty creatures dwelling in the well and slow your decent with each shot. 

Unique Weapons & Items - Get different weapons, shop for peculiar items and obtain powerful upgrades that all stack and affect the way you play!

A New Adventure Every Time - Each level in Downwell is procedurally generated, so no two trips down the well are ever the same providing a fresh new adventure each time!

Music by Eirik Suhrke. 
Sound Design by Joonas Turner.

逆水寒.name: 逆水寒
逆水寒.description:
《逆水寒》手游是一款国风开放世界武侠游戏，以精湛细腻的画质、真实灵动的江湖氛围、颠覆传统MMO套路、智能AI深度植入影响游戏世界而著称，被称为“会呼吸的江湖”。游戏以纯粹的东方古典审美，结合现代芯片图形技术，形成了格调不凡、自成一派的游戏美术风格。又以颠覆性的游戏设计理念，和对角色扮演游戏陈旧套路的反叛，以及将国风武侠结合开放世界的诸多新奇尝试而获得了玩家的广泛期待。

《逆水寒》手游改编自“华语武侠四宗师”之一的温瑞安先生的经典武侠文学作品《四大名捕之逆水寒》，故事发生在行将崩坏的北宋末年，一个贯穿江湖、市井、朝廷、外敌、魔教五方势力的布局精巧诡异的阴谋正在逼近，玩家作为局外人被无辜卷入，在见证了背叛、逃亡、反抗等诸多变故之后，成为所有江湖风暴的中心，并收获绝世神兵、盖世神功以及真正拥有侠气的知心好友后，最终发现所有江湖偶遇，都是宿命相逢。

《逆水寒》手游拥有诸多游戏特色：

【大有可玩的宏大武侠开放世界】
逆水寒手游打造了一个具有浓郁东方美学底色的宏大开放世界，玩家将在唯美的大宋自然风光中开启冒险：驰骋大宋山河，征服高山险峰与地穴密道，寻觅失落的神兵绝技；运用金木水火土等中华五行元素破解谜题，找寻隐藏的宝藏；施展武学招式与奇异巨兽、流匪盗寇野外搏斗，收集罕见的奇珍异宝。
游戏还全景式还原了《清明上河图》式的市井百态，玩家将在细腻的烟火气息中体验百味人生：起舞吟唱、拉弓射虎、拍案惊堂...通过近百种江湖身份开启第二人生，沉浸式融入繁华的大宋市井生活，甚至因此在江湖中声名大噪。

【不肝不氪，自由养成】
不肝：首创“殊途同归”，玩家可按照喜欢的玩法与熟悉的方式闯荡江湖，收益都能拿满；删除日常周常一条龙，破除MMO所有陈旧套路；
不氪：开创了MMO开放世界游赛季制手游，装备全靠打，还神功神兵于江湖；
自由养成：颠覆想象的自由武学搭配，与人切磋暗地偷师，磨练之中领悟怪招，恰逢奇遇又习绝技！坦克也能学治疗，奶妈也可爆发输出！搭配上百种江湖技能，削弱了传统MMO游戏中“职业门派”对玩家的束缚，把定义自己的权力还给了玩家。

【深度融合AI，颠覆NPC】
国内首款为 NPC 加载人工智能引擎的手游，并与游戏机制深度融合，玩家可与NPC无限交流，甚至插手NPC私生活，改变江湖走向！高智能AI NPC，将为玩家带来耳目一新的游戏体验，NPC真正实现了“有血有肉有思想”，NPC会记得玩家对他说过的话做过的事，并基于深度学习不断给予玩家真实的智能反馈。利用AI技术为游戏世界营造出了鲜活的江湖真实感和无限可能。

【海纳百川的乐趣融合，丰满扎实的单机RPG体验】
除了充满乐趣与惊喜的冒险与探索，以及层次丰满的对战竞技体系之外，逆水寒手游还融入天量经典游戏模式：逆转裁判式的断案，底特律变人式的蝴蝶效应，拳皇式的横板格斗；游戏内容量大管饱、奇趣精妙，并且不逼迫社交，单人体验时长超100小时，支持单人打本，完全可以当做单机开放世界RPG游玩。

【社恐福音，休闲为王】
破除了传统网络游戏“强制玩家社交”的怪圈，基于AI技术打造“NPC亲友团”，为社恐玩家实现了“单人可打团本”机制，堪称更适合中国社恐宝宝的网络游戏。
逆水寒手游强调求同存异的游戏乐趣，重视休闲玩家生活玩家的游戏体验，各类休闲向的“轻玩法”极其丰富，而且可以同样收获游戏核心奖励。种田钓鱼、下棋观光、游历考古，这些传统角色扮演游戏中“不务正业”的玩法，在逆水寒中可一样可以融入主流。

逆水寒手游诚邀您重铸国风巅峰，期待继续和万千玩家在会呼吸的江湖中遇见，一起携手，让MMO再次伟大。
所有江湖偶遇，都是宿命相逢。

恋与制作人.name: 恋与制作人
恋与制作人.description:
自然的每一刻都在上演进化与淘汰
司空见惯中窥见世界另一面的少女，以及背负各自宿命、不期而遇的人们
要么为了不被淘汰而保持奔跑
要么对抗残酷的未来而奋起反抗
在重重迷雾与陷阱中，向着名为真相的未来—
勇敢地前进吧！
这是属于你的爱和梦想，那就都要棋逢对手

游戏特点：
【跌宕剧情 超越现实悬念迭起】
与日常生活中不同职业的隐藏超能力者近距离接触，在追逐真相的同时逐渐了解不寻常的事实
著名声优献声，在跌宕起伏的超现实世界中体验心动！

【心动羁绊 收藏故事升级回忆】
海量精美人物CG，定格每一次心动
收集升级羁绊，将回忆转化为力量。

【专属时光 甜蜜约会手机互动】
还原现实社交，同时搭载短信、通话、朋友圈及公众号功能
随时随地和他定下一场甜蜜的约会！

【精彩拍摄 定格镜头下的恋人】
制作专属节目，全方位报道属于你的男主角
从工作中的他到生活中的他，在点点滴滴中相遇相知相识。

【公司经营 打造顶尖影视品牌】
无论是险象横生的离奇事件，还是光怪陆离的都市传说
每一次探索都是新鲜感的释放，每一篇报道都是经营者的用心。

【支持设备】
需要IOS 9.0或更高版本，与iPhone、iPad、iPod touch兼容。

【特别说明】
已有游戏账号的玩家可直接使用手机号登录游戏；预约期间在官网注册过的玩家可直接使用官网账号登录游戏，方便领取官网预约活动奖励。

未定事件簿.name: 未定事件簿
未定事件簿.description:
《未定事件簿》是米哈游研发的律政恋爱推理手游，你将扮演新人律师，在与他携手解决离奇委托的过程中，被卷入不为人知的阴谋。这是一场恋爱x推理的冒险，你将做出怎样的抉择？

“接下这份委托，你将面对一场豪赌。赢则功成名就，输则万劫不复。”
你，还只是一个对未来抱有美好向往的新人律师。在解决委托的过程中，被意外卷入不为人知的阴谋。
一桩桩看似无关的案件，却隐藏着千丝万缕的联系。
幕后黑手将世间常理颠覆，彻底撕碎关于未来的一切美好愿景。
当事件的真相被重重迷雾所掩盖，当善与恶的界限变得模糊，当言语沦为最无力的辩白……
当苦苦追寻的结果与世人背道而驰的那一刻——
你还会坚持最初的选择吗？

【动态卡面 捕捉每个心动瞬间】
近百张精美动态卡面，捕捉每个心动瞬间。每张约会卡面都有剧情记录，铭刻与他一起的点点滴滴。

【线索收集 探索揭秘故事真相】
高自由度3D现场搜证，环环相扣的证物证言分析。你将通过细致的调查与严谨的推理，抽丝剥茧揭开真相。

【专属陪伴 逐步走入他的内心】
海量剧情文本，沉浸游戏体验。你可以探索他不为人知的另一面，逐步走入他的内心世界。还能与他亲密互动，指尖感受恋爱的温度。

关于我们：

官方微信：未定事件簿
官方微博：@未定事件簿
官方论坛：https://bbs.mihoyo.com/wd/

世界之外.name: 世界之外的愚人船
世界之外.description: This is a visual novel, in reality we create different worlds that belong only to you for various reasons, and they will gradually fade away with your memories. Please enjoy this time traveling in different worlds with the girls, and then return to where you are meant to exist - your life.

Sand Drop! - Color Sort Puzzle.name: Sand Drop! - Color Sort Puzzle
Sand Drop! - Color Sort Puzzle.description:
Sand Drop! – Color Sort Puzzle is a relaxing 3D puzzle game built around colorful sand, careful choices, and satisfying collection.
Each level features a beautiful 3D sand painting inside a glass sand tank. Your goal is to place the right buckets beneath the openings and gather the matching colors as the sand falls. Every bucket has limited space, so choosing the wrong color can leave you without the room needed to complete the level. Sort the correct buckets to achieve your victory.
Study the artwork, anticipate which colors will fall next, and plan the order of your moves. As the sand shifts and the painting gradually breaks apart, hidden layers and new color combinations are revealed.

What to expect:
- Satisfying 3D sand-collecting puzzles
- Colorful sand paintings that transform as you play
- Smooth sand physics and relaxing visual effects
- Strategic levels with no time pressure
- Increasing difficulty through clever layouts and color sequences
- Simple mechanics that reward thoughtful planning
Watch vibrant 3D artworks come to life, then collect them one color at a time. Find the best sequence, fill every bucket, and enjoy the satisfying moment when the final grain of sand falls into place.

鸣潮.name: 鸣潮
鸣潮.description:
《鸣潮》是一款跨平台开放世界动作游戏，主打高自由度的动作战斗玩法与丰富多样的开放世界探索。而你，在这个世界苏醒的漂泊者，将在找回记忆、寻找自我身份的同时结识无数的共鸣者同伴，并和伙伴一起踏上改变这个世界的旅途。

◆荣获The Game Awards2025玩家之声◆
◆提名The Game Awards2025最佳移动游戏◆
◆提名The Game Awards2024玩家之声◆
◆提名The Game Awards2024最佳移动游戏◆

◆游戏介绍◆
漂泊的旅人，欢迎在这里醒来。
涨落无声，我们的世界刚刚经历一场退潮。
悲鸣降临，人类被旧日的法则遗留，文明于滩涂搁浅。
但所有静默之后，是不遗余力的发声。
随毁灭一同出现的异象，同样带来了新生，人类正与它们一起，开创全新纪元。
而你——漂泊者，你的旅途才刚刚开始。
或是邂逅并肩作战的伙伴，对峙无法想象的劲敌，或是吸纳改变自身的力量，揭露颠覆一切的真相，又或者，只是探索未曾目睹的奇观，尽可能延伸你能抵达的边界……我们无从知晓你将做出的选择，但我们期待你在灾厄余音中找到的答案。或许，你就是那个带领人类跨越滩涂的人。
潮声循环往复，文明再度启程。
请踏上，属于你的旅途。


◆游戏特色◆
——探索开放世界 / 世界失序 文明启于悲鸣之后
《鸣潮》是一款开放世界游戏，拥有高机动性的探索体验。解放奔跑体力限制、蹬墙跑酷、自由翱翔、驾驶高机动性的科考摩托，享受无拘无束的开放世界探索。作为在索拉里斯的世界苏醒的漂泊者，你将在这个无边开放世界中开启一段找回回忆、寻找自我身份的旅程。
 
——极致动作体验 / 行云流水 体验高速流畅战斗
作为一款动作游戏，《鸣潮》拥有高速且流畅的战斗体验，在战斗中轻松使用极限闪避、逆势回击、声骸协战、特色的QTE等玩法，让每一场战斗酣畅淋漓。
 
——沉浸式剧情演出 / 细腻视听 见证每个动人故事
《鸣潮》致力于玩家提供优质的游戏声画体验，通过高品质的剧情、音乐、动画演出，让每一位漂泊者在《鸣潮》的索拉里斯世界中沉浸式体验每一个动人的故事。
 
——结识共鸣者同伴 / 共鸣觉醒 旅途之中结伴同行
在旅途中，你将结识许多能力各异的共鸣者伙伴，陪伴你一同探索未知的未来。每位共鸣者都有着各自独特的个性与能力，为你的《鸣潮》之旅提供不可或缺的助力。

◆关注我们◆

官方微博：@鸣潮
官方微信：鸣潮
官方抖音：鸣潮

放开那三国.name: 放开那三国
放开那三国.description:
《放开那三国》金卡时代波诡云谲，群雄并起。“跨服资源矿”玩法开启，快来抢占宝石资源扩充军备吧！新增宝石功能，镶嵌宝石，让你的装备无坚不摧！

S级卡牌手游《放开那三国》全新绝美武将让你尽收囊中，更多福利活动倾情回馈！
自App Store上架以来，稳居畅销榜前列，创造三国题材卡牌手游领先地位。
《放开那三国》——放不开的手机游戏！快乐，从此触手可及！

游戏特色：
1.超萌Q版画风，怪蜀黍、小正太、软妹子轮番登场，让你大呼过瘾！
2.完善卡牌收集系统，三国群英一网打尽，绝色后宫随你组建！
3.超高紫卡爆率，贴心的入门教学。新手一秒变大神，菜鸟瞬间成高玩！
4.独创怒气系统，极致的战斗体验，让你的武将爆框再爆框！
5.道具全产出，所有游戏道具均可在游戏内产出，减少玩家差距，增大游戏乐趣！

投诉受理：tousushouli@babeltime.com
官方微信：SG_babeltime

Duck Survival.name: Rubber Duck Survival
Duck Survival.description: Rubber Duck Survivor is a 2D survival game where you control a rubber duck and face over 30 bosses plus 1 secret boss. Unlock skins, defeat challenging bosses, and face waves of enemies. Can you overcome the challenge?

梦幻花园 (Gardenscapes).name: Gardenscapes
梦幻花园 (Gardenscapes).description:
Welcome to Gardenscapes, the first game from the Playrix Scapes™ series! Make match-3 combinations and bring coziness and beauty to every corner of your garden.

Solve fun puzzles, restore and explore new areas of the garden, and meet new friends in every chapter of the exciting storyline. Austin the butler is ready to welcome you to a world of incredible adventures!

Game Features:
● Gameplay loved by millions of players! Make match-3 combinations and decorate your garden while enjoying an entertaining story!
● Over 16,000 captivating levels with explosive power-ups, useful boosters, and cool elements.
● Exciting events! Embark on fascinating Expeditions, compete against other players in different challenges, and win awesome prizes!
● One-of-a-kind garden areas with unique layouts, from fountain ensembles to island landscapes.
● Loads of fun characters: meet Austin's friends and neighbors!
● Adorable pets that will become your faithful companions!

Play with your Facebook and Game Center friends, or make new friends in the game community!

Gardenscapes is free to play, but some in-game elements (including randomized items) can be purchased for real money. If you don't want to take advantage of this option, simply turn it off in your device's Restrictions menu.

A Wi-Fi or internet connection is not required to play.
 *An internet connection is required to access competitions and additional features.

Do you like Gardenscapes? Follow us!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Gardenscapes
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gardenscapes_mobile/

Need to report an issue or ask a question? Contact Player Support through the game by going to Settings > Help and Support. If you can't access the game, use the web chat by clicking the chat icon in the lower right corner of our website: https://playrix.helpshift.com/hc/en/5-gardenscapes/

Merge Mansion.name: Merge Mansion: Puzzles & Story
Merge Mansion.description:
Welcome to Merge Mansion – the original merge puzzle game with cozy gameplay, epic adventures and high drama!

Restore a forgotten mansion to its former glory – and solve mysteries along the way! Can you uncover the secrets Grandma is hiding and reveal the truth behind the Boulton family’s past?

Unlock spaces and rooms in the garden and mansion by completing fun merge tasks. Collect clues, meet fascinating characters, and piece the story together one mystery at a time.

Relax into this cozy merge puzzle game packed with more twists and turns than Grandma’s knitting.

MATCH & MERGE
Merge matching items to upgrade, and use them to complete tasks. Enjoy the satisfaction of creating and discovering new items and chains!

RENOVATE & DECORATE
Restore the mansion and gardens to their former glory! Collect themed decorations and customize your home as you wish.

INVESTIGATE & SOLVE
Uncover hidden areas and combine clues to find out what secrets Grandma is hiding - how far down the mystery rabbit hole will you go?

EXCLUSIVE EVENTS
Play limited-time events to gain points, climb leaderboards, collect gorgeous decorations, and win big rewards!

Merge Mansion is the number one destination for a cozy mystery puzzle adventure - and it never gets boring! Download this free puzzle merge game and discover its secrets.

——————————

Did you get stuck or run into a problem? Visit our support page in the Merge Mansion app or send us a message at mergemansionsupport@metacoregames.com.

——————————
Merge Mansion is free to download and play. Some in-game items can also be purchased for real money. You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device’s settings. Merge Mansion may offer randomized virtual items for purchase.

Merge Mansion may be updated from time to time for content or technical updates. If you do not install the provided updates, Merge Mansion may not function properly or at all.

这是一个关于末日、冒险、孤独和寻找自我的故事。
人们的生活因为科技的发展飞速变化着...直到很久以后的一天，早已被淘汰的育儿机器人Abi找到沉睡中的工业机器人DD，在逃离废弃仓库的那一刻，他们发现，整个地球的人类似乎都神秘消失…...人类去了哪里？这个世界发生了什么？经历了漫长的旅程，鲸鱼船终于将他们带到了人类梦寐以求的大都市，大都市能实现他们的梦想吗？所有的谜底等你和Abi，DD一同发现。

小冰冰传奇.name: 小冰冰传奇-官方怀旧服
小冰冰传奇.description:
【游戏简介】
官方正版，经典怀旧！国民动作卡牌手游《小冰冰传奇》官方怀旧服现已上线，无VIP限制、无魂匣和泰坦系统，PA、DP免费领，永久月卡登录送，上线天天拿钻石！
欢迎各位队长回家，重温2014年原汁原味的简单快乐！

【耐玩！原汁原味，再玩十年！】
用策略搭配百种英雄阵容，用微操实现技能打断、集火、击杀、技能组合，瞬息万变的战局一秒创造。这套原汁原味的动作卡牌玩法，穿越十年，还是好玩！

【英雄！跨越十年，情怀不变！】
在人族、兽人、暗夜精灵、巨魔等诡奇生物横行的传奇大陆，灵魂守卫、酒仙、天怒法师、灰烬之灵......承载着十年青春回忆的经典情怀英雄陆续登场！

【轻松！休闲不肝，简单快乐！】
拒绝“打工”！休闲不肝、不考验操作，却依然能感受英雄的养成快乐、丰富的策略可能。让你每天从工作生活中“缺勤”半小时，这才是小冰冰传奇的简单快乐！

【良心！福利加码，策划听劝！】带着十年的情怀和诚意，策划大力重置怀旧服，剔除VIP限制、魂匣和泰坦系统，全英雄无门槛获取！还有PA、DP免费领，永久月卡登录送，上线天天拿钻石！我们的目标是，重现百花齐放的竞技场，做最长寿的国产手游！

万国觉醒.name: 万国觉醒
万国觉醒.description:
>>>若古中国与古罗马爆发战争，凯撒与曹操在战场上相遇，谁是赢家？
>>>在战争策略游戏中加入MOBA和RTS，多人对抗遇上即时战斗，会是一种怎样的体验？
>>>八万人在一个广阔而自由的世界，探索、采集、生产、发展、战斗，会发生什么样的故事？
 
答案就在这里！
 
《万国觉醒》创造了一个你从未见过的战场——
横跨欧亚，15个古代文明供你选择，重演历史进程。世界传奇领袖在此集结，曹操、凯撒、源义经、腓特烈……人类历史上最亮眼的璀璨明星，在这个庞大而真实的沙盘世界上相遇，集结至你的麾下。
 
你作为英雄们的执政官，从地图一隅起家，探索战争迷雾，集结联盟军团；
随着实力增长，你将和同盟一起征战圣所，据守要塞划分领地，称霸一方；
当迷雾隐去，世界全貌显现，巨大战争棋局呈现于眼前，强敌环绕周遭，或联合或征伐，人人皆渴望争霸世界中心神庙王座。
纵横捭阖之间，剑所指的方向，乃是万国之巅。
 
欲通往王座，你不仅需要具备宏观战略视野，同样也要善于临场战术指挥——《万国觉醒》模仿真实战争逻辑，自由行军即时战斗，军队可自由控制在地图上任意行进、驻扎，遇敌可临时开战，若局势不对也可撤兵脱战。自由行军操作带来丰富的战术演绎空间，使每一场战斗都充满变数。
 
在这种战斗模式下，战争场面也变得极为宏大和直观。千人同屏的实时军团会战每天在各处上演，一切在大地图上即时发生，向你演绎大即是美、多即是好的冷兵器战争美学。
 
即便王座落定，游戏的后期也不会陷入无聊和枯燥，这是一个从不止战的世界——未来有30V30的联盟匹配对决、八大王国乱战的跨服对战，还有各种赛季制玩法丰富长线体验，用不同的地图、玩法和场景，让你的战术策略与战略运筹获得更多施展的空间。
 
从不止战，也不止于战。自由行军可以演绎精彩战术，也可以成为表达情感的工具，排列庆典仪仗，上演各种或欢乐或温馨的时刻。执政官们在此并肩而战，延伸出友谊与情谊，唯有一个自由而真实的世界，才能使人与人的关联产生如此真实的羁绊。 
 
这，就是《万国觉醒》。
 
执政官，跟上我们的脚步
 
——千军万马，即时开打！

使用条款：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

妄想破绽.name: 妄想破绽：重构篇
妄想破绽.description: 当你虚构的角色实体化成为活人之后，这一切都脱离了控制。当人力足以影响一切，规律可以改写，真伪可以调换，那么——你又是谁？是真是假？有何证据？谁能证明？你如愿以偿地，真正成为了“不存在之人”。阳光下的和平实则杀机四伏，黑暗中的真相亦是走投无路，不应存在的你，是被弃之无用，还是改写战局？

风帆纪元.name: 风帆纪元
风帆纪元.description:
→App Store上线连续一周在中国大陆、中国港澳台区域 iPhone 付费榜排行第二，iPad 付费榜排行第一。
→入选2025年中国大陆区域App Store独立游戏周合集并获Today推荐以及App Store游戏首页推荐。
→多次入选中国港澳台区域 App Store“编辑爱游戏”“游戏上架推荐”“新春畅玩游戏” 等多个推荐位，玩家反馈良好。
→Steam 上线连续一周热销榜排行第一，中国区新品销售榜单第一，全球热销榜第八。

童年偷偷躲在屏幕前，为《大航海时代》里发现新大陆而欢呼雀跃的日子，你还记得吗？那些在像素港口与商人斗智斗勇、在海战中热血拼杀的珍贵记忆，是多少人心中永不褪色的航海梦！怀揣着对经典的敬意，作为一款超拟真大世界航海经营冒险单机手游，《风帆纪元》即将同步面向国内玩家开启航海征程！复刻记忆中的航海魂，融入颠覆性创新玩法，带你重走儿时向往的航海之路，这一次，换你亲自书写震撼世界的海上传奇！

四国船长主角！谁能主宰海洋？
四个来自不同国度的船长，怀揣着截然不同的野心与秘密！是手握战刀，将整片海洋踏在脚下的铁血霸主？还是凭借智慧与谋略，掌控全球商路的商业帝王？每一个选择，都将彻底改写大航海时代的历史！你，准备好以谁的身份，在这片惊涛骇浪中留下自己的印记了吗？

30+传奇伙伴！组队制霸五湖四海！
牛津学者的智慧、传奇海盗的疯狂、犹太商贾的狡黠……30+身怀绝技的传奇伙伴，正等待与你组队！和他们一起破解古老航海密码，突袭神秘宝藏岛屿，开辟隐秘商路！这里没有独行侠，只有并肩作战的王者之师，你，会是那个让他们甘心追随的领袖吗？

真实海域！每一次航行都充满未知
1:1复刻15世纪地球海域，每一阵风、每一场雨、每一次海浪的咆哮都暗藏杀机！前一秒还风和日丽，下一秒暴风雨就能将你的船只撕成碎片；平静的海面下，随时可能窜出海盗的舰队！但这又如何？动动手指操控帆舵，征服这片桀骜不驯的海洋，建立属于你的海上霸业！你，有这个胆量吗？

日式美学！每一帧都美到窒息
吉田明彦风格的古典幻想画风，搭配复古光影滤镜，直接将中世纪航海绘本搬进手机！哥特式港口在血色残阳中宛如恶魔城堡，东方楼阁在粼粼波光中若隐若现！阳光洒在海面，金箔般的光芒随船而动——这里的每一处风景，都值得你向全世界炫耀！你，不想成为这片绝美海洋的主人吗？

史诗剧情！你就是历史的主角
从哥伦布发现新大陆到郑和下西洋，真实历史事件与奇幻冒险完美融合！和历史名人并肩作战，亲历改变世界的伟大时刻！开放世界+网状任务，你的每一个决定，都将推动历史的车轮滚滚向前！你，难道不想成为那个被历史铭记的航海英雄吗？

现在！立刻！启航！这片充满宝藏与危险、荣耀与挑战的海洋，正在向你发出最后的邀请！是龟缩在现实的角落，继续做一个旁观者？还是登上《风帆纪元》的战船，成为15世纪的海上传奇？答案，就在你的手中！

90年代的《大航海时代》是我们童年难忘的情怀与回忆，我们在《风帆纪元》中倾注了从“大航海”中获得的热情与梦想，希望通过《风帆纪元》致敬经典，并在这里为玩家们绘制出一个跌宕起伏的“航海新旅程”。茨威格的《人类群星闪耀时》中描述道：大量看似平凡的事件在历史长河中按部就班地流动着，但在某个瞬间，那些事件汇聚在一起，就像避雷针的顶端汇聚了整个电场，决定了整个历史的走向。
——我们正为了呈现出这样的体验而努力着。

如遇到任何困难、对游戏有任何反馈或是想找到志同道合的航海家，欢迎加入我们官方QQ群：

暖雪.name: 暖雪
暖雪.description:
朱门酒肉臭，路有冻死骨！ 
四大家族助纣为虐！天罚将至！ 
逆天犯顺，必有异象。 
七月飞霜，唯有血偿。 

《暖雪》是一款暗黑风武侠类的动作Roguelite游戏。游戏以诡异的“暖雪”为核心打造了一个完全架空的黑暗奇幻世界，你将扮演代号“狴犴”的侠士去讨伐五大家族，拯救这个摇摇欲坠的世界！ 

【剑与雪的黑暗传说】 
龙武二十七年，天空突降怪雪，此雪不寒且温，亦不融。后世称之为“暖雪”。吸入“暖雪“的人丧失神智，变成怪物。自此人间堕入疯狂，世界飘摇欲坠。这一切的背后……究竟是天怒降罚，还是邪神作祟？ 将由你来探寻。 游戏中，你将作为侠士“狴犴”踏上旅途，寻找暖雪背后的真相，让黑暗迎来终结！ 

【自由搭配出万种变化】 
七大宗派，百般圣物，莫测神兵，丰富的Rogue元素让你百玩不厌。 七大独特宗派，十四种核心玩法，搭配海量神兵与圣物，每种圣物拥有四种完全不同的特殊效果，神兵又能与特定宗派联动诞生奇妙反应，每一次进入世界都是一场全新体验，选择你最喜爱的玩法，用万般过关方式，挑战无限可能。 

【超爽感的飞剑系统】 
剑来亦去，光影之间，灰飞烟灭。你可以操纵各式属性的飞剑对敌人进行多样化的打击，连携近战攻击与多种圣物加成，你可以一招制敌，亦可飞剑如雪，享受专属于你的畅爽战斗快感。 

【不断重生制敌，收集真相的碎片】
你可以通过消耗红色灵魂自由分配点数到天赋树中，永久地加强自己的能力。
没有人能直接告诉你暖雪世界的真相…….一切藏在随机掉落的“记忆碎片”之中，而你将不断重生制敌收集碎片。准备好发现五大家族间不为人知的骇人秘闻，层层剥开隐藏在故事背后的真相了吗？

【针对移动端进行的优化】
· 自定义键位及自动瞬身：根据你的喜好调整按钮的位置及大小，通过开关启用左摇杆自动瞬身。
· 自由调整视距：根据你的喜好调整屏幕显示的大小。
· 自动索敌：通过开关启用近战自动索敌，加倍丝滑战斗体验。

硬核机甲.name: 硬核机甲启示
硬核机甲.description:
【真·动作机甲】
微操、高速移动、喷射回避；射击、白刃近战、特写必杀；不论在何时何处，《硬核机甲启示》始终贯彻亲自操纵机甲的自由与浪漫！就用你的驾驶告诉大家吧，机体的性能并不是战斗胜败的决定性因素！

【坚定原创机体】
机甲是浪漫的，机甲也是现实的。在《硬核机甲启示》中，我们以故事世界观和机甲作为兵器的定位为基础，反复思考求证，力求不断设计制作出帅气洗练又有说服力的各型各色机体，满足各位指挥官的独特喜好！

鬼谷八荒.name: 鬼谷八荒
鬼谷八荒.description:
《鬼谷八荒》是一款开放世界的沙盒修仙游戏。结合了修仙体系与山海经文化背景，体验从凡人一步步修行成长为强者的过程，与山海经中各种妖、兽战斗。你是否能坚守本心，与困难做斗争；慎做抉择，把握自己的命运。

【遁入修仙世界，开启逆天人生】
鬼谷八荒, 除了财侣法地，还有诡秘莫测的妖兽，危机重重的秘境，难以逾越的天堑，彩光四射的秘宝，等着被人发现。
你将作为一个炼气期小修士从愚村出发，修炼，变强，危机中九死一生。每一次突破，你都能逆天改命，助你在旅途中披荆斩棘，跨越五大州，睥睨天下，再闯上天元山，向天道一问。
【ai互动生态，给NPC完整的一生】
我们构建了完整的NPC互动生态，他们“生活”在这里，有自己的朋友亲族关系网，自己的人生轨迹，不受玩家的进度限制，除非，你决定出手干涉。
你可兼济天下，携手红颜；你可独善其身，快意恩仇；你亦可逆天而行，与全世界为敌。
和NPC们切磋武艺，传授道心，拜师学艺，收徒授业。和NPC在拍卖场喊价厮杀，结束后拔刀相向或顺手牵羊。你将成为修仙界群像中的一部分，是大放异彩，还是默默修行，皆看你如何选择。
【体验小说桥段，感受奇遇惊喜】
英雄救美？爱人为你争风吃醋？五十年之约？卷入神秘组织的明争暗斗？遗迹遇宝？又惨遭夺宝？
这些都有可能发生在你身上。
除NPC交互之外，这里还有丰富的随机事件以及支线任务，在你的旅途中给予惊喜。它们或许会让你烦恼，喂你刀子，也可能让你化险为夷，甚至破而后立。在一步又一步的选择的过程中，你将谱写只属于你的，独一无二的故事。
【打造最强宗门，攻城略地一统八荒】
我们构建了宗门的经营玩法，身为弟子，长老以及宗主，将会有不同的体验。你可以加入大宗门，从最底层的弟子做起，一步步爬上权力的阶梯。也可以空降落魄的小宗门，力挽狂澜，带领宗门重振雄风。
弟子可以完成宗门任务，在宗门大比中出战，或随同门出征作战，为宗门积累资源，为宗门赢取荣誉，为宗门扩张土地。
长老可以管辖门下弟子，传道授业，分配任务职能，加速宗门成长，在宗门大战中指导弟子大杀四方。
宗主则需要统筹全宗的秩序，制定侵略和防守计划，攻防灵矿等资源点，甚至占领他人宗门，夺取专属逆天改命和秘籍。
一统八荒，只要你有宏图壮志和铁腕手段，不再只是幻想。
【构筑独特流派，挑战妖兽神仙】
闯荡这世界，需要有傍身之技。
心法筑根基，武技/灵技探深浅，身法创机会，绝技造优势，神通定乾坤。不同秘籍有不同的特性。
修仙者还有十二大灵根，对应不同的流派，你可以选择专精一路，或全面发展。十二种灵根都有对应的功法秘籍，排列组合可组成丰富的流派，孰强孰弱，皆由你评断。
城镇琅琊阁，宗门功法阁，秘境，各种任务，甚至路边一个土坑里，都可能发现珍奇秘籍，充满惊喜。
这个世界上还有上百种珍奇妖兽，无数修仙者，鬼怪，仙人供您检验自己的实力。挑战升仙擂台，冲击各大洲参玄榜，以此证明自己的实力。你能否踏破冥山的障碍一路向前？构筑的流派能否经历大浪淘沙的检验？
【法宝器灵炼丹画符，三大神器伴前路】
练好自身本领，也别忘了外力加持。
开局三大神器，每一个都会给你带来一种独一无二的系统。双鱼佩可以复活自己和选中之人，昊天眼可以偷学妖兽技能，洞察更多信息，而炼妖壶则可以让你捕获BOSS成为你的小跟班，替你战斗或派遣寻求宝物。
除了开局神器之外，你也能炼制你自己的法宝，并收服器灵与你一起战斗，此外器灵还会在探索中给予你陪伴，触发专属的奇遇等等。
在这里，你还可以学习炼丹画符，堪舆风水，制作帮助你探索世界，整蛊仇人，战斗杀敌的种种道具。至于如何发挥它们真正的作用，皆看各位道友如何抉择。

失落城堡.name: Lost Castle / 失落城堡
失落城堡.description: Lost Castle is an action RPG beat'em up with roguelike elements and randomized dungeons for up to four players online and local!

迷失岛.name: 迷失岛
迷失岛.description:
苹果官方2016年度“最佳独立游戏”作品！

“迷失岛”是一座位于大西洋海域的神秘小岛，玩家需要通过层层解谜才能找出这个岛上埋藏的秘密。传统点触类经典解谜，极度烧脑的游戏解谜关卡，神秘又美丽的画面，南瓜先生大冒险团队最新力作，2017年最值得期待解密类独立游戏之一。

游戏的目的是协助玩家调查一个大西洋海域的小岛，找出这个岛上潜藏的秘密。

游戏特点：
1、超多细节的游戏场景，描绘出了一个孤独而又神秘的海岛景象。
2、鲜活的动画风格，独特的游戏人物，让人过目难忘。
3、层层嵌套的谜题，让玩家体会到解谜的终极乐趣。
4、多个精心准备的益智小游戏，挑战玩家智商，彰显小岛的神秘。
5、出人意表的对话内容，意料之外的情节发展，带领玩家探究故事的真相。
6、游戏成就系统，让玩家体会到探索的成就和荣誉。隐藏成就献给支持我们的玩家。
7、二周目的游戏内容，在增强了游戏的可玩性之外，也让整个小岛的故事更加丰满。
6、2015年IndiePlay(独立游戏嘉年华)最佳美术提名奖。

官方Q群：383441918（欢迎探险者们）
意见和反馈：contact@cottongame.com

南瓜先生.name: 南瓜先生2 九龙城寨(Mr. Pumpkin 2: Kowloon Walled City) Demo
南瓜先生.description: Mr. Pumpkin 2: Kowloon Walled City is a sequel to the Mr. Pumpkin franchise. Our protagonist will explore the Kowloon Walled City of Hong Kong, and witness the stories happening within these walls. It is a tribute to the golden age of Hong Kong films.

Sifu.name: Sifu
Sifu.description: Sifu is a realistic third-person brawler with tight Kung Fu combat mechanics and cinematic martial arts action embarking you on a path for revenge.

生化奇兵.name: Mars Troopers - 生化奇兵2019
生化奇兵.description: Mars Troopers must defeat the enemy to save the universe. Super exciting shooting game, waiting for you to challenge! Action games, Arcade games, Crime games, fight games and for those fans of guns weapon games.20+ Alien Monsters Boss, 9 different alien stars, Waiting for you to conquer.

无主之地.name: 4X-Galaxy 无主之地：银河
无主之地.description: “4X-Galaxy” is a game developed by the 4X concept system(eXplore、eXpand、eXploit、eXterminate)

XCOM.name: XCOM® 2
XCOM.description: XCOM 2 is the sequel to XCOM: Enemy Unknown, the 2012 award-winning strategy game of the year. Earth has changed and is now under alien rule. Facing impossible odds you must rebuild XCOM, and ignite a global resistance to reclaim our world and save humanity.

演灭.name: 演灭 EVOTINCTION Soundtrack
演灭.description: The Original Sound Track from EVOTINCTION - featuring 17 tracks.

王者荣耀.name: 王者荣耀
王者荣耀.description:
王者荣耀：5v5团队公平竞技游戏
【游戏介绍】
《王者荣耀》是腾讯第一5V5团队公平竞技手游，国民MOBA手游大作！5V5王者峡谷、公平对战，还原MOBA经典体验；契约之战、五军对决、边境突围、王者模拟战等，带来花式作战乐趣！10秒实时跨区匹配，与好友开黑上分，向最强王者进击！多款英雄任凭选择，一血、五杀、超神，实力碾压，收割全场！敌军即将到达战场，王者召唤师快来集结好友，准备团战，就在《王者荣耀》！
【游戏特色】
1、5V5越塔强杀！开团
5V5经典地图，三路推塔，呈现最原汁原味的对战体验。英雄策略搭配，组建最强阵容，默契配合极限666！
2、随时开团！10分钟爽一把！
适合手机的MOBA游戏，10分钟享受极致竞技体验。迂回作战，手脑配合，一战到底！人多，速来！
3、团队公平竞技！好玩不坑拼实力！
凭实力carry全场，与团队共赴荣耀。不做英雄养成，不设体力，还你最初的游戏乐趣！
4、指尖五杀！风骚走位秀操作！
微操改变战局！手速流？意识流？看我风骚走位，力压群雄，打出高端操作！收割，连杀超神！

【特别说明】
在游戏《王者荣耀》中，用户登录时可以选择“与QQ好友玩/与微信好友玩/游客登录”，三种登录方式在iOS设备上的游戏数据不互通（包括等级、钻石、金币等）。用户在游戏中购买的游戏代币“点券”仅限在本应用中使用。腾讯的虚拟货币，比如Q币、Q点无法在本应用中使用。
游戏隐私政策详情，可查阅https://rule.tencent.com/rule/d277ee20-2709-4cd5-882b-cbd485753346
【联系我们】
如果您喜欢我们的游戏，欢迎随时给我们评价、留言。
官方网站：http://pvp.qq.com
官方微信：heromoba

洛克王国：世界.name: 洛克王国：世界
洛克王国：世界.description:
《洛克王国：世界》是腾讯魔方工作室群自主研发的精灵大世界游戏。基于童年回忆“洛克王国”IP，集精灵收集对战、开放世界探索与自由轻松社交于一体，打造充满回忆与美好的新洛克王国！

不卖精灵更不抽精灵，400+精灵免费捉！多体系战斗，公平博弈无穷乐趣！多端全平台互通，单人漫游或组队同行随心选！魔法、奇景、孵蛋、偷菜、打扮！只需按你喜欢的方式游玩，寻找你独一无二的羁绊，这里就是我们儿时梦中的洛克王国世界！

魔法重启，童年返场。小洛克，欢迎回家！

Slice Away.name: Slice Away
Slice Away.description:
Ready to slice everything in your way?
Every swipe feels satisfying in Slice Away! Cut through everyday objects with smooth controls, realistic physics, and relaxing ASMR effects. Slice everything into perfect pieces before the timer runs out and complete increasingly challenging levels.

From tiny objects to massive creations, every stage offers a fresh slicing challenge. Upgrade your cutting power, unlock new blades, and expand your Slice Factory as you become the ultimate slicing master.

Slice Away Features
- Master satisfying slicing gameplay with smooth controls, realistic cutting physics, and relaxing ASMR effects.
- Race against the clock to slice every target before time runs out. Think fast, cut efficiently, and beat increasingly challenging levels.
- Slice hundreds of unique objects, from everyday items to surprising new creations waiting to be discovered.
- Upgrade your blade to cut faster, slice stronger, and tackle bigger objects with ease.
- Build and expand your Slice Factory as you progress through exciting new stages.
- Compete in limited-time events and challenges to earn exclusive rewards and prove your slicing skills.
- Climb the leaderboards and become the ultimate Slice Away master.
- Play with friends, exchange gifts, and earn even more rewards together.

Whether you're looking for a relaxing ASMR experience or a fast-paced slicing challenge, Slice Away delivers satisfying gameplay that's easy to learn and impossible to put down.

Download Slice Away today and become the ultimate slicing master in the most satisfying object slicing adventure!

NumMatch.name: NumMatch: Number Logic Puzzles
NumMatch.description:
NumMatch - Logic puzzle is the perfect relaxing number game. 

Immerse yourself in the world of math number games! Playing this game will let you relax, especially after a work day; solving a free puzzle every day will train your brain and maths skills. Become a match number master!

HOW TO PLAY:

- The goal is to clear all the numbers from the board.

- Find pairs of equal numbers (1 and 1, 7 and 7) or pairs that add up to 10 (6 and 4, 3 and 7) on the number grid.

- The pairs can be cleared vertically, horizontally, and even diagonally when there is no barrier between them and at the end of one line and the beginning of the next.

- When no matches are on the board, you can tap to add new numbers on the puzzle pages.

- If you get stuck in this logic game, Hints are available to help you progress 

- Try to clear the numbers on the board to achieve the highest score

DAILY CHALLENGE AND GIFT 

For extra fun, we have prepared something special for you. Play Nummatch Journey with 100 new block puzzle games every week for free! Each NumMatch puzzle has a different goal: collect gems and excellent awards!

Enjoy your daily achievements and unlock cool badges, which will cheer you up!

 FEATURE:

- Play easy with no pressure or time limit.

- Unlimited free Hints - Stuck? No worries, easily continue with one tap!

- Play every day and complete daily challenges or seasonal events to get unique trophies.

- Gorgeous visuals paired with delightful sound effects.

- Update hundreds of new puzzles every week

- Play anytime and anywhere. No WiFi connection is required!

NumMatch Logic Puzzle is the perfect way to test your problem-solving skills and train your brain. So what are you waiting for? Experience the addictive NumMatch today!

If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us at support@matchgames.io

HoleCraft.name: HoleCraft - Black Hole 3D Game
HoleCraft.description:
SWALLOW THE VOXEL WORLD

Welcome to Holecraft, the ultimate satisfying teardown experience. Take control of a massive black hole and embark on a relaxing journey to swallow entire 3D voxel worlds. From towering buildings to tiny details, nothing is safe from your hungry void.

Watch in awe as gravity pulls complex voxel structures apart, piece by piece, dropping them endlessly into the depths.

HOW TO PLAY
- Slide your finger to move the black hole smoothly across the board.
- Position the hole under various voxel structures to tear them down.
- Swallow blocks to grow your hole larger, allowing you to consume even bigger objects.
- Clear the entire map to complete the level and unlock new surprises.

DISCOVER DIVERSE THEMED WORLDS
Every level presents a beautifully crafted mini world waiting to be devoured. Each map offers a completely new visual experience. Expand your black hole to swallow a peaceful Farm, consume a busy Airport, or tear down a highly secured Military base. Explore unique themes including traditional Japan towns, deep Under Sea landscapes, magical Mushroom forests, and massive Sport arenas.

KEY FEATURES
- SATISFYING TEARDOWN: Experience the pure ASMR joy of watching complex 3D voxel structures collapse into the void.
- ENDLESS GROWTH: Start small by eating tiny props and grow massive enough to swallow entire cities.
- STUNNING ART STYLE: Enjoy beautiful pixel art and colorful voxel graphics across hundreds of levels.
- RELAXING GAMEPLAY: No timers, no stress, and no complex rules. Just smooth, calming block consumption.
- OFFLINE MODE: Enjoy the game anytime and anywhere, with no internet connection required.

THE ULTIMATE RELAXATION
Whether you want to unwind after a long day, clear your mind, or simply enjoy the visual thrill of voxel destruction, Holecraft is the perfect escape. The smooth controls and mesmerizing physical collapse of the blocks make every level highly addictive.

Ready to consume everything? Download Holecraft today and start growing your black hole!

If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us at support@matchgames.io

Blockanza.name: Blockanza: Block Puzzle
Blockanza.description:
Welcome to Blockanza! Dive into a colorful world of block puzzles that will keep you entertained for hours. Simple to play yet challenging to master, Blockanza is perfect for all ages. Match, clear, and blast through hundreds of levels and become the ultimate puzzle master!

Game Features:

- Engaging Gameplay: Match and blast block to clear the board.
- Daily Challenges: Solve new puzzles daily and earn rewards.
- Stunning Graphics: Bright and colorful visuals.
- Offline Mode: Play anytime, anywhere, and no internet is needed.
- Brain-Boosting Fun: Enhance your problem-solving skills.
- Combo Rewards: Score big with powerful boosters.

How to Play:

- Drag blocks onto the grid.
- Blast lines vertically, horizontally, or square path
- Rotate blocks to fit them perfectly.
- Clear the board and progress through levels.
- Aim for high scores to become the top player.

Join the Blockanza community and start your block-busting adventure today! Download now!

If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us at support@matchgames.io

We are using the standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA) (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/). For more information about the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use, please check this link: https://matchgames.io/privacy-policy/ 
If you have any questions or comments, feel free to contact us at support@matchgames.io.

Junkyard Survival.name: Junkyard Survival
Junkyard Survival.description:
Enter the wasteland and turn a battered scrap vehicle into an unstoppable survival machine.

Junkyard Survival is a fast-paced vehicle survival game where you drive through dangerous post-apocalyptic junkyards, collect scrap with a powerful front-mounted magnet and fight endless waves of hostile vehicles, machines and junkyard bosses.

Every run begins with a basic vehicle. Explore the battlefield, pull scattered metal parts toward your magnet and gather the resources needed to grow stronger. As the enemy waves become more dangerous, choose new weapons, upgrade your equipment and create a vehicle build capable of surviving the chaos.

DRIVE AND COLLECT SCRAP
Move freely through open junkyard battlefields while your hanging magnet pulls nearby scrap toward your vehicle. Destroy enemies, collect the parts they leave behind and search the environment for additional resources, crates and power-ups.

The stronger your magnet becomes, the more scrap you can collect from a greater distance.

BUILD YOUR COMBAT VEHICLE
Transform your vehicle by equipping powerful weapon attachments, defensive parts and utility upgrades.
Each attachment changes how your vehicle fights. Combine close-range weapons, long-range attacks, area damage and defensive upgrades to create your own survival build.

CHOOSE NEW SKILLS DURING EACH RUN
Gain experience by defeating enemies and collecting resources. When you level up, choose from different upgrade options that improve your weapons and vehicle.
Increase damage, attack speed, range and cooldown efficiency, or unlock special behaviors that completely change how an attachment works.
Build around rapid machine-gun fire, explosive missile attacks, burning damage, electric chain reactions, aggressive ramming or heavy armor.

USE POWERFUL COMBAT POWER-UPS
Find temporary power-ups that can turn a dangerous battle in your favor.

Activate abilities such as:
• A powerful magnet burst that pulls in nearby scrap
• Molotov strikes that spread fire across the battlefield
• Force fields that destroy surrounding enemies
Use each power-up at the right moment and watch its cooldown before activating it again.

FIGHT MASSIVE JUNKYARD BOSSES
Survive long enough and powerful boss vehicles will enter the battlefield.
Bosses combine multiple weapons and attack patterns, including side-mounted flamethrowers, artillery attacks, spinning saws, reinforced wheels and heavy armor.
Learn their patterns, avoid their strongest attacks and destroy them to claim valuable rewards.

UPGRADE YOUR MAIN VEHICLE
Improve your permanent vehicle between runs.

Upgrade simple and easy-to-understand attributes such as:
• Health
• Speed
• Magnet Power
• Damage
As your vehicle improves, it becomes larger, stronger and more heavily equipped, with bigger wheels, improved armor and a more powerful magnet.

EXPLORE MULTIPLE JUNKYARD WORLDS
Battle through different post-apocalyptic regions, from dry desert scrapyards to harsh green wastelands filled with industrial ruins, broken machinery, abandoned structures and environmental hazards.
Each world introduces new enemies, stronger waves, different battlefield layouts and increasingly dangerous bosses.

CREATE A NEW BUILD EVERY RUN
Choose different weapons and upgrades each time you play.
Experiment with long-range firepower, close-range destruction, high-speed movement, defensive armor or powerful area attacks. No two survival runs need to use the same strategy.

FEATURES
• Fast vehicle-based survival gameplay
• Automatic weapon attacks
• Responsive driving and enemy dodging
• Magnet-powered scrap collection
• Multiple weapon attachments
• Utility items and combat power-ups
• Random skill choices during each run
• Permanent vehicle progression
• Diverse enemy vehicles and attack behaviors
• Large multi-weapon boss battles
• Multiple junkyard environments
• Colorful, stylized 3D graphics
• Simple controls designed for mobile play

Collect the scrap. Build your machine. Survive the junkyard.

Balance Jam!.name: Balance Jam!
Balance Jam!.description:
Dive into the exciting world of Balance Jam! 

Balance Jam is a thrilling and addictive puzzle game that will put your coordination to the test! 
Tap the colorful cubes in the correct order to send them upward, but keep an eye on the balance board. One wrong move and it’s game over!
Can you master the balance and beat the challenge?

Unpack Match.name: Unpack Match
Unpack Match.description:
A new and innovative Match game!

Unpack all your stuff and match them by groups of 3 to free up space.

BounceToHole.name: BounceToHole
BounceToHole.description:
Build Paths. Explode the Monsters. Solve the Puzzle!


Move unique-shaped blocks to create paths across the grid. Match each source to its hungry monster by color!


Think ahead, explore the board, and uncover the perfect route. With satisfying mechanics, playful animations, and levels that grow more mind-bending, it's the perfect blend of strategy, creativity, and fun.

Can you feed them all without getting blocked?

Plan smart. Feed fast. Master the maze.

Find Guys.name: Find Guys
Find Guys.description:
Find Guys takes you on a search through a huge world of scenes, cozy cafés and ancient wonders, enchanted forests and roaring battlefields, quiet streets and places you'd never expect. In every one of them, sneaky guys have painted themselves to blend into the environment. A sleeve that matches the curtains. A face hidden in a mural. Legs posing as chair legs. They're literally hiding in plain sight.

What starts as a casual look-around quickly sharpens into a real test of perception. Early scenes train your eye; later ones hide their guys so well you'll swear the picture is empty. Then you spot one, and another, and the whole scene snaps into focus. That moment, when the camouflage breaks and the hidden becomes obvious, is what Find Guys is all about.

Each level is a small world worth exploring on its own, packed with detail, humor, and little stories. Some guys give themselves away if you're patient. Others demand you question every shadow, pattern, and paint stroke. And once you've found them all, a fresh scene is always waiting.

In Find Guys, you will:
- Search stunning, detail-packed scenes from fantasy to real life
- Spot guys painted to perfectly blend into their surroundings
- Sharpen your eye as camouflage gets craftier with every level
- Enjoy that satisfying "there he is!" moment, again and again

They painted themselves to disappear. Your eyes say otherwise. Can you find all the guys?

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Waste The Fallen.name: Waste The Fallen
Waste The Fallen.description: A cosmic-horror extraction shooter. Drop in, loot up, and get out alive: raid decaying zones for gear, survive the monsters lurking inside, and escape before the dark closes in. Solo or up to three, with other Deviants hunting the same loot.

Crows.name: Wildwood: Follow the Crows
Crows.description:
Find and collect sculptures across Portland while unlocking exciting rewards and milestones along the way. Discover the design inspiration and vote for your favourite. Share your photos to the sculpture photo galleries while tracking your steps and miles. Keep up to date with the latest trail related news and events. 

Art trail app includes: map, sculpture listings, artist bios, design inspiration, sculpture and milestone rewards, sculpture photo galleries, voting, trail stats, social sharing and event listings.

Wildwood: Follow the Crows is a Wild in Art event presented by LAIKA, benefiting OHSU Doernbecher Children’s Hospital.

Wild in Art is a leading creative producer of spectacular, mass-appeal public art events, which connect businesses, artists and communities through the power of creativity and innovation.

For 20 years, LAIKA has pioneered the field of animation--creating award-winning films, handcrafted by visionaries and artists. We're raising the bar, pushing boudaries, and redefining the kinds of stories this artform can tell. 

For 100 years, OHSU Doernbecher Children’s Hospital has changed young lives through expert care and the unwavering support of its community. From the very beginning, Doernbecher made a simple but powerful promise: to care for every child in need.

For 38 years, Downtown Portland Clean & Safe has worked to help create a cleaner, safer, and more welcoming downtown. As some of downtown’s biggest champions, the organization also leads the Visit Downtown campaign, inviting people to experience all that Portland’s central city has to offer.

三角洲行动.name: 三角洲行动
三角洲行动.description:
《三角洲行动》是一款由琳琅天上团队研发运营的新一代战术射击品质标杆游戏。PC及移动端版本在9月正式上线！未来将继续登录主机平台。拥有25年历史的经典射击鼻祖再次回归，这一次行动难度升级。

作为全球反恐特勤组G.T.I.的精英特战干员，你将前往神秘的阿萨拉大陆，调查哈夫克公司的非法活动。在这个充满危机的战场中，运用别具特色的战斗道具与装备，与队友紧密协作，灵活制定战术，完成各种看似不可能完成的极限行动。

中远距离战术战斗、秘密潜入解决目标、驾驶重型载具火力输出、海量随机事件、几十人的大战场对决……在这里，你将获得丰富又刺激的作战体验。

”无所畏惧，绝不言退。”

游戏特色

【鼻祖回归，全新兵种战术射击！】
在这里你能体验到最经典的特战干员作战风格。
作为全球精锐小队一员，在各系列的经典地图中，体验中远距离的观测与狙击、充满策略性的战斗方式，让你领略到为何三角洲得到全球如此多玩家的喜爱。

【迎难而上，挑战不可能的任务！】
延续三角洲历代作品强调的战术性，打造了一个震撼的无缝动态世界——阿萨拉。每片区域都蕴含了不同的危机。选择你自己的作战方式、行动任务，完成挑战。但请记住，随时保持警惕，灵活使用你的战术道具和战术技能，动用脑力战胜对手！

【活用战术，成为全球最佳干员！】
在这里，你可以自由选择干员，而每一个干员都是绝对的精英。
精通各干员的特殊技能和战斗方式，你将成为精英中的精英。
面对看似不可能的任务，拉上同样强大的队友，组建无所不能的小队，让不可能成为可能。

【冷静应对，完成烽火地带撤离！】
这里的一切危险都是未知。闻声而来的黑潮、随机空降的哈夫克雇佣兵、以及不知在哪里埋伏的真人小队……找到目标，击败对手，完成任务！
只有最强的干员才能全身而退，看你的了。

【改装搭配，打造顶级枪械作战！】
在资深军事顾问的协助下，突击步枪、冲锋枪、狙击枪、霰弹枪、轻机枪，数十把枪械、每把武器超10种改装部位，都像真家伙一样呈现在你面前。
在超千种组合搭配中，挑出你最喜欢的那一个，出发！

【驾驶载具，驰骋拟真全面战场！】
在广大的地图战场上来一场多人团战！你可以驾驶冲锋艇、主战坦克、武装直升机、装甲车、全地形车等近10款载具驰骋大战场，火力全开！
是时候放下冷静，放肆一把了！

mo.co.name: mo.co
mo.co.description:
We’re recruiting monster hunters to join the action, help us fight back the invasion, and harvest.. eerr.. gather Chaos Energy from parallel worlds to fuel our weapons tech and some other experiments that you don’t need to worry about!

Disclaimer: mo.co is free to download and play, and never has in-game ads. However, some game items can also be purchased for real money (including random items). If you don't want to purchase game items for real money, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.

Perks of the job: 

● Super-powerful, Chaos Energy-infused weapons for you to fight with!
● Flexible working hours…  it’s a ‘start hunting whenever you want’ situation
● Cool merch that lets you embody the monster hunting lifestyle. 
● Unlimited Portal jumps to parallel worlds. 
● Fun team environment with plenty of co-op action. 
● Fun leave-me-alone environment where you can hunt solo if that’s your thing. 
● No experience necessary. 

Start your monster hunting career at mo.co to enjoy a working environment that lets you… 

ENJOY BITE-SIZED ADVENTURES

Every day we launch new expeditions, whether you want a quick hunt or a longer session with friends, our portal technology lets you jump in and out of adventures whenever you want. 

EARN, MASTER, AND UPGRADE POWERFUL WEAPONS

Unlock a variety of Chaos Energy infused weapons. Each one comes with special abilities that let you unleash epic combinations. Make your weapons even stronger and enable other power-ups like health regeneration or dodging using Upgrade Cores. 

EXPLORE PARALLEL WORLDS 

Dragonling world has peaceful spirits being tormented by these chaotic lizards. Royal Bug world is a hierarchical society that will not tolerate mo.co’s free-spirited adventures. There’s no telling what worlds the portal will take us to next… 

PROVE YOUR SKILLS 

Elite Contracts put hunters right in the action, against the strongest bosses & tricky situations you’ll need to fight your way out of. If you succeed, you’ll earn Elite Merits, Elite Merch Credits, and climb the leaderboards. 

TAKE DOWN BOSSES WITH FRIENDS

We are a company but we hate bosses. When you join mo.co you’ll be put up against challenging monsters and you'll need to learn their attacks to find the best way to take them down. 

FIND MERCH TO FIT YOUR MOOD

From epic outfits that’d make any action hero feel powerful to stylish streetwear that matches your weapon, we’re always dropping merch to push the monster hunting lifestyle forward. 

SPRAY, EMOTE, AND DANCE YOUR HEART OUT.

Leave your mark with sprays, let friends know your mood with emotes, or start dancing in the face of monsters with gestures. 

HUNT ALONE OR TOGETHER

Adventure through parallel worlds solo and crush challenges in the DOJO, or fight with other online hunters for serious multiplayer action. 

COLLAB WITH OTHERS

Hunt together to defeat the biggest bosses and most chaotic monster hordes. Whether it’s with real life friends, or other random mo.co hunters, we’re a team out there. By planning weapon choices together you’ll be able to take down the most intimidating of Chaos Monsters. 

Support: 

Having problems? Visit https://support.supercell.com/mo-co/en/index.html or contact us in game by going to Settings > Help and Support.

Privacy Policy: http://www.supercell.net/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: http://www.supercell.net/terms-of-service/
Parent's Guide: http://www.supercell.net/parents
The IGRS Rating for this game is 13+

Notice of Access Permission:
[Optional permission]
mo.co may request permission via in-game pop ups to access your camera and send you notifications.
Camera: For in-game scanning of QR codes
Notifications: For sending notifications related to the game
Consent is optional and you can use the app and play the game regardless of whether or not you consent. You may refuse to give consent within the game. However, certain app features may not work properly if you refuse optional access permissions.

RuneScape.name: Old School RuneScape
RuneScape.description:
Old School RuneScape 

Old School RuneScape is the iconic fantasy MMORPG that defined a generation. Based on the original 2007 version of RuneScape, this is the only major MMO RPG shaped entirely by its players, with new content voted into the game by the community. 

With over 300 million accounts created since 2001, RuneScape remains one of the world’s most played online role-playing games. Whether you're new to Gielinor or returning for the nostalgia, Old School RuneScape delivers a deep, evolving sandbox RPG adventure. 

Master 24 Skills, Including Sailing 

Train across 24 unique skills, including the new Sailing skill. Captain your own ship, explore uncharted islands, and uncover powerful rewards on the open sea. 

From Combat and Slayer to Fishing, Runecrafting, and Sailing, this open-world MMORPG offers true progression and freedom. 

Choose your path: 
• Max every skill
• Build a PvP account
• Play as an Ironman
• Or explore at your own pace 

This is your MMO, play your way. 

Epic Quests & Story Adventures 

Embark on hundreds of immersive quests filled with humour, danger, and rich fantasy storytelling. Solve mysteries, defeat legendary foes, and shape your character’s legacy. 

From early-game beginner quests to Grandmaster challenges, Old School RuneScape delivers classic RPG quest design with modern depth. 

Bosses, Raids & Endgame PvM 

Take on powerful bosses and conquer epic raids, including: 
• Chambers of Xeric 
• Theatre of Blood 
• Tombs of Amascut 

Whether you're learning how to survive your first raid, or you're chasing the title of raid master, Old School RuneScape offers some of the most rewarding PvM in any MMORPG. 

Explore a Vast Open World MMO 

Adventure across the enormous world of Gielinor, from desert kingdoms and haunted swamps to tropical islands and now the open seas. 

Every region unlocks new training methods, bosses, skilling activities, and unforgettable quests in this living fantasy MMO. 

True Cross-Platform Gameplay 

Play Old School RuneScape on mobile and desktop with one account across the same game worlds. Skill on the go, complete a quest on mobile, then raid on desktop, your progress stays with you. 

Free-to-Play or Become a Member 

Start your adventure for free, or unlock the full MMORPG experience with Membership: 
• 9 additional skills 
• Hundreds more quests 
• Exclusive bosses and raids 
• Expanded world map and bank space 

Download Old School RuneScape today and begin your adventure in the world’s most community-driven MMORPG. 

Privacy policy: https://legal.jagex.com/docs/policies/privacy 
Terms and conditions: https://www.jagex.com/terms  
Do Not Sell Or Share My Personal Information: https://www.jagex.com/en-GB/terms/privacy#do-not-sell

不心动才有鬼.name: 不心动才有鬼
不心动才有鬼.description: With sudden powers, meet 6 unique girls in an extraordinary campus romance. Campus beauty, teacher, maiden, or girl next door... sweet or dangerous, all have secrets. Don't Blush is a 1st-person FMV romance where your choices shape everyone's fate. Beyond boundaries, beyond mere sparks.

完蛋！我被美女包围了！.name: 完蛋！我被美女包围了！-房间里的心跳VR花絮
完蛋！我被美女包围了！.description: 《Love Is All Around-Love In The Room》 is a full first-person perspective, immersive is a relationship experience 3DVR work, the whole process is shot in first-person perspective, fully immersed in the scene interaction and real-life simulation.

女神异闻录.name: 女神异闻录：夜幕魅影
女神异闻录.description:
白天感受潮酷都市生活与青春恋爱日常，放学后化身怪盗团队长，带领伙伴们潜入异世界夺取秘宝，体验你的双面人生！ 

《女神异闻录：夜幕魅影》（简称：P5X）是获得了SEGA正版IP授权，由ATLUS全面监修深度参与，完美世界游戏倾力打造的异世界都市冒险JRPG，力求在深度还原原作独特视听风格的基础上，为玩家带来全新的精彩体验！

战神.name: 1.80战神微变
战神.description: 全新传奇《1.80 战神微变》打破传统战法道界限！全新「神器使者」单职业登场，集近战爆发、远程范围、辅助增益于一身！

古剑.name: 白荆回廊——古剑奇谭
古剑.description:
于世界交点之处，逢似曾相识之人。
欢迎来到——“森罗”。
森罗历1116年4月1日13时46分，海临城北区上空出现巨大空洞，一个破碎的世界砸落，世界纷纷交汇于此……
不久后，带有未知能量的结晶体自废墟中析出。在此后的研究中，发现了受该未知晶体影响而觉醒特殊能力的群体，他们被称为——“同调者”。
人们被迫进入了一个全新的时代，一个与未知能量共存的、属于「白荆科技」的时代。

《白荆回廊》是一款异世交汇即时多维战斗RPG。游戏采用虚幻引擎开发，立足于独特庞大的世界观，采用2D与3D并重、细腻多样的美术风格，多元化的角色塑造，创新的策略战斗以及丰富的互动及拓展玩法。在这里，你将作为「白荆科技」的最高执行官，与众多“异世来客”相遇，携手抵御前所未见的风险，去探寻引发动荡的缘由。

官网地址：https://seed.qq.com/
官方微信公众号：白荆回廊
官方微博：白荆回廊

古剑奇谭三.name: Gujian3(古剑奇谭三)
古剑奇谭三.description: Gujian 3 is a mass 3D single-person RPG developed by Aurogon Info & Tech (Shanghai), a subsidiary of Wangyuan Shengtang. As the latest hit of the Gujian series, it boasts more free and smooth combat experience with its full real-time combat system. This generation expands the world of Gujian based on previous works.
